title: Apple Will Lower Daily AI Usage Limits for Some Staff to as Low as $25
summary:
The tech company is intensifying its crackdown on corporate spending by introducing tighter restrictions on the amount employees can spend on artificial intelligence tools. Apple plans to lower the daily usage caps to $100 for certain engineers, while other teams may see their limits drop to $25.

These measures follow a previous reduction that saw daily caps for some engineering staff fall from $300 to $200. The spending cuts occur as Apple continues to push its workers to integrate the technology more frequently into their daily operations.
